summary: An excerpt from a fiction novel (labeled 'Book 10 — part 19') in which Lawrence, in a New York hotel room, reflects on a conversation about a sister who was 'disappeared,' noting that the speaker used the past tense. Noisy voices from the adjoining room and the view of New York keep him restless. He then goes to Penn Station, where a Securitat man scans and detains him, while his wearable 'pan' malfunctions and leaves him anxious, with the scene cut off mid-description of the Securitat outpost.
one_line: Lawrence, in a New York hotel and then Penn Station, reflects on a disappeared sister while a Securitat man scans and detains him.
key_facts: Lawrence notes that zbigkrot used the past tense to describe his sister, suggesting she had been disappeared.
Zbigkrot quotes his sister as having told him, 'If I was you, kid, I'd just disappear before someone disappeared me.'
Lawrence stares at the walls of his hotel room while at least four people, speaking Chinese, occupy the room next door.
New York is visible outside the hotel window, with the sun bright on cars, buildings and sunglasses far below.
Lawrence is not getting anywhere with the docs, the sister, or the data streams.
Lawrence digs his boots out from under the bed, where they are covered in dust-furred old socks.
A Securitat man points at Lawrence as he walks past Penn Station, and Lawrence points at himself in a who-me? gesture.
Lawrence's pan, a device on his body, reacts to the Securitat man's scanning by trying to wipe itself.
The Securitat man ignores Lawrence's request to lower his arms so the pan can be told to let the man in.
The Securitat man leads Lawrence through a door into a narrow corridor deep in Penn Station.
Passengers on the Penn Station concourse part magically before Lawrence and the Securitat man without making eye contact.
Lawrence's pan nags at him about the station and the Securitat man, leaving his heart and breathing racing.
Lawrence considers this pan malfunction a bad failure mode he has never experienced before and plans to file a bug report someday.
The Securitat's outpost in Penn Station is as clean as a dentist's office, with mesh-reinforced windows and locks that click three distinct times.
